description: Mode is determined by the inputs: prompt only is text-to-video, prompt + image is image-to-video.

prompt.description: Describe the scene, action, camera and sound. The chosen style is applied automatically.
examples: A skateboarder cruises down a palm-lined boulevard at sunset, upbeat synth music.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: Optional first-frame image. Artwork in the chosen style gives the most consistent look; its aspect ratio sets the canvas.
image.title: Image

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. Ignored when an image is given.

damage_level.description: VHS style only: tape wear from subtle analog noise (light) to strong tracking errors (heavy).
damage_level.title: Damage Level

title: AppInput
